name: Matrix
description: You have a string of decimal digits s . Let's define b ij = s i · s j . Find in matrix b the number of such rectangles that the sum b ij for all cells ( i , j ) that are the elements of the rectangle equals a in each rectangle. A rectangle in a matrix is a group of four integers ( x , y , z , t ) ( x ≤ y , z ≤ t ) . The elements of the rectangle are all cells ( i , j ) such that x ≤ i ≤ y , z ≤ j ≤ t .
input_specification: The first line contains integer a ( 0 ≤ a ≤ 10 9 ), the second line contains a string of decimal integers s ( 1 ≤ | s | ≤ 4000 ).
output_specification: Print a single integer — the answer to a problem. Please, do not write the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the cin , cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
approach_summary: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N using Fermat's Little Theorem (mod 10^9+7 or 998244353). Answer nCr queries in O(1) time per query.
